body:
Template Craft
This mod is created by someone who isn't fond of templates, yet doesn't fully oppose them either.
 
It adds durability to templates, so they are no longer consumed in one use—instead, their durability depletes upon use.
It's compatible with other templates as long as their tags match.
 
The mod is still in testing with AI-assisted development. Some bugs are quite obvious, but they won't affect core gameplay.
Say no to one-time-use templates with no durability!
